RxVideo.ZedAddress_comment: IP address of the Zedboard receiver
RxVideo.ZedPort_comment: its TCP port for commands and results
RxVideo.ZedUdpPort_comment: its UDP port for the CoreBoard's sample stream
RxVideo.Push_ms_comment: the board pushes results at most this often while there are new ones, 0.25 to 7.75 ms
RxVideo.DcShift_comment: receiver DC blocker: 6 for the CoreBoard
RxVideo.Play_comment: 1: play the received video with ffplay
RxVideo.SaveStream_comment: 1: also save the received stream to App/Rx_CoreBoard/Video/Received.ts (large)
